# smalldi

> Small, annotation-driven dependency injection for Python 3.11+. Install with `pip install smalldi`.

Core API:

- `from smalldi import Injector, Provide`
- `@Injector.singleton` on a class registers it; its single instance is created lazily, when it is first injected (thread-safe; circular dependencies raise `TypeError`).
- `@Injector.inject` on a function (or `__init__`) fills parameters annotated `Provide[T]` with the `T` singleton. Dependencies are resolved on the first call, so `T` may be declared after the function but before it is called; a missing one raises `TypeError` on call. Explicit keyword arguments override injected values.
- `@Injector.implements(Iface)` placed above `@Injector.singleton` binds that singleton to an interface, so `Provide[Iface]` injects it. An interface has one such baseline; a second one raises `smalldi.InterfaceAlreadyBoundError`. The interface must not itself be a singleton (`TypeError`).
- `@Injector.override(Iface)` (also above `@Injector.singleton`) replaces the baseline, once, in either declaration order. Pass `on=lambda: <condition>` to apply it only when the condition holds at decoration time; the override is validated either way. Changing what an interface resolves to after it was first injected raises `smalldi.InterfaceFrozenError`.
- `from smalldi.container import Container`: subclass it, decorate the subclass with `@Injector.singleton`, then register components with `@MyContainer.component` or `@MyContainer.component(*meta, **meta)`. Inside the container, `self._get_components()` yields registered components; override `_on_component_register(registration)` to react to registrations.
- `from smalldi.collector import Collector`: `Collector.collect_from_package("pkg")` imports every module in a package so their decorators run. Call it only from a top-level module to avoid circular imports.

Example:

```python
from smalldi import Injector, Provide

@Injector.singleton
class Config:
    url = "sqlite://"

@Injector.singleton
class Db:
    @Injector.inject
    def __init__(self, config: Provide[Config]):
        self.url = config.url

@Injector.inject
def main(db: Provide[Db]):
    print(db.url)

main()
```
